children: Grovy Developers, an award-winning real estate developer in Dubai, has broken ground on Ramada Residences by Wyndham at Dubai Islands, marking the start of main construction on the boutique branded residences.
The project is developed in partnership with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts and USquare Luxe Properties, the landowner and development partner.

The groundbreaking follows the signing of the agreement with Wyndham and the unveiling of the project's show apartment earlier this year.With enabling works complete and structural works now underway, the development has reached a key stage of construction.

Grovy Developers has appointed Jaseera Building Contracting as the main contractor for the project. Established in 2018, the Dubai-based contractor has built a strong reputation for delivering residential, commercial, and industrial developments across the UAE, with expertise spanning civil, structural, MEP, and fit-out works.

Its portfolio includes a range of landmark projects across the UAE, alongside several ongoing developments in Dubai and the wider region. Drawing on its multidisciplinary team and end-to-end construction capabilities, Jaseera will oversee the development through to completion, ensuring it is delivered to the specifications and quality standards agreed with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.

Abhishek Jalan, CEO of Grovy Developers, said: "Breaking ground is the point at which commitments become physical. When we signed with Wyndham, we committed to delivering the project to a high standard, and today, the development is progressing well against that commitment. "Appointing Jaseera Building Contracting gives us a delivery partner with the capacity and the site experience to hold that schedule, and we will be measuring progress against it every month."

Ramada Residences by Wyndham at Dubai Islands comprises a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with four-bedroom penthouses, all delivered fully furnished. Residents will benefit from hotel-grade services and operations underpinned by Wyndham's quality assurance, alongside more than 20 leisure amenities including an aqua gym, golf simulator, open theatre, and a temperature-controlled infinity pool. The development is among a select number of residences approved for short-term leasing on Dubai Islands, giving owners additional flexibility and income-generating potential.

The development is located within Dubai Islands, a master-planned waterfront destination designed to offer a blend of residential, hospitality, leisure and retail experiences, with beaches, green spaces and connectivity to key destinations across Dubai.
